headline: **MLB Daily Recap**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Cleveland Guardians 1-0, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win after 7.0 innings of scoreless ball, striking out 9 and walking 1. The Washington Nationals secured a 7-10 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the charge at the plate, going 3 for 5 with 2 home runs and 3 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates edged the Chicago Cubs 8-7 in a closely contested matchup.

Several players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Kerry Carpenter has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left foot plantar fasciitis with the Detroit Tigers. Other players on the injured list include Spencer Steer (right wrist sprain with the Cincinnati Reds), Cody Bellinger (left hamstring strain with the New York Yankees), Shea Langeliers (torn meniscus in right knee with the Athletics), Mike Paredes (left oblique strain with the Minnesota Twins), Josh Jung (left calf strain with the Texas Rangers), Spencer Arrighetti (right foot nerve irritation with the Houston Astros), and Juan Soto (left calf strain with the New York Mets).

Several teams have made roster moves. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles for cash. The Athletics acquired Scott Blewett from the St. Louis Cardinals for cash. The Chicago White Sox acquired José Urquidy from the Pittsburgh Pirates for Felix Doroteo. The Boston Red Sox traded Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals for Curtis Mead.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Guardians in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Cleveland Guardians 1-0, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win after 7.0 innings of scoreless ball, striking out 9 and walking 1.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 10-7**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 7-10 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the charge at the plate, going 3 for 5 with 2 home runs and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged the Chicago Cubs 8-7 in a closely contested matchup. Ryan O'Hearn led the Cubs' offense with a home run and four RBIs, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Pirates' late-game surge.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Fall to Red Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, winning 6-1. Jarren Duran led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Mariners 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a 7-3 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with several players making significant contributions to the win. Impact hitters for the Rangers included Ezequiel Duran and Evan Carter, while Kumar Rocker was a standout pitcher.

top_news.title: **Carpenter Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers right fielder Kerry Carpenter has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left foot plantar fasciitis.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Rodríguez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right fielder Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash. Rodríguez joins the Pirates' roster.
